_comment: Market-bot config. Phase 7a ships the pricing engine (scripts/admin_market.py) + a read-only market view only; the order-posting / d12-gamble-buy bot loop is 7b and is OFF until verified. Pricing uses the Coastal sane-pricing model: list price = vendor_price x vendor_multiplier (or a tier/stack fallback) x grade_multiplier, step-rounded, hard-capped at price_cap. The 7b bot fields (max_listings, gamble_die/target, max_buys_per_tick, scan_interval_secs) are recorded here for when the loop lands.
